question.question: 是否按此方案开发？
question.description:
目标: 在助手消息中渲染 AG-UI CUSTOM 事件 app.inspection.result（value 含 target 与 checks[]：name、status、可选 detail.code/message/duration_ms）：通过项紧凑列出，失败项高亮显示并可点击展开失败原因，支持复制错误详情。

目标插件与位置: inspection-result-message

需要新增的能力: 现有消息渲染插件仅注册 CONTEXT_CONTENT 事件名，不处理 app.inspection.result; 现有插件无法按通过/失败分组呈现检查项，也没有失败原因展开与复制详情交互

Application-headless message renderer (data.messageUI, registered by CUSTOM event name), composed at the application target like context-retrieval-message

proposal.desiredOutcome: 在助手消息中渲染 AG-UI CUSTOM 事件 app.inspection.result（value 含 target 与 checks[]：name、status、可选 detail.code/message/duration_ms）：通过项紧凑列出，失败项高亮显示并可点击展开失败原因，支持复制错误详情。
missingCapabilities: 现有消息渲染插件仅注册 CONTEXT_CONTENT 事件名，不处理 app.inspection.result
现有插件无法按通过/失败分组呈现检查项，也没有失败原因展开与复制详情交互

deliveryContract.capability: Renders app.inspection.result CUSTOM events as an inspection result card inside assistant messages
deliveryContract.placement: Application-headless message renderer (data.messageUI, registered by CUSTOM event name), composed at the application target like context-retrieval-message
deliveryContract.lifecycle: Registers a data message UI for the app.inspection.result event name; renders only when the Agent emits that CUSTOM event, no Runtime or Service changes
dependencies: existing application locale service via useAgentUILocaleCode
interactions: failed check expands to show detail code/message/duration
copy error details button copies failure detail
keyboard-operable expand control and visible button labels
